Abstract synthesizes the conditional model and separately proposed institution. Equal-portfolio equivalence is exact; no probability, perpetual-solvency or investment-performance claim.
Purpose dedication rather than an absolute ban on asset sales is the working definition. Enforceability is a design requirement, not universal legal availability.
An adequately funded ordinary reserve is the comparator. Resources, obligations and competence may not be reduced merely to favour the proposal.
Continued service is the proposed governing objective; capital price, fund balance and service capacity are not identified.
Accounting allocation does not itself create usable resources. No jurisdiction-specific accounting rule is asserted.
Read NIST's distinctions between inflation and discounting, and present-value evaluation and budget provision. No handbook rate is used as a current local financing recommendation.
Read NBER abstract, including activity costs and other institutional resources. The correlated rental/repair application is our hypothesis, not an empirical estimate attributed to Merton.
Read official description of land transfer with invested support for continuing management. Marketing assurances about removing risk are not repeated.
Read official account of property endowment and property/investment income; other continuing income acknowledged. No apartment scheme's indefinite solvency inferred.
125 units, EUR 10 million cost, EUR 120,000 equal net price and no construction borrowing are chosen arithmetic assumptions, not observed market estimates.

No calibrated returns, hazards or local tax model. Constant-price emergency property sales omit transaction costs, favouring liquidation. Accounting/funding distinctions, not investment rankings.
Proposed service company separate from client ownership/custody; not an empirically demonstrated global business or executable universal entity.
Proposed connection of engineering, finance, authority and records; a solvency guarantee would be a separate capitalized/insured product.
Role table proposes separation of recommendation, authorization, payment and inspection, not a universal legal chart. Local powers and independent conflict controls required.
Prior delegation with limits, notification and review proposed; statutory duties not overridden.
Proposed access/custody/record portability makes removal practical; does not defeat insolvency or creditor law.
Tenant interests may differ from voting owners. Proposed reporting, reasons and challenge routes supplement technical judgment.
Read archived draft on task-dependent production scale and polycentric services. Paraphrase only, no quotation. Commercial stewardship application is our proposal, not Ostrom's finding.
Shared professional systems do not require shared asset ownership. Pooling/mutual support require separate authorized claims, liquidity and exit rules.
Conceptual liability-matching limit omitted by euro model. Diversification can introduce mismatches requiring local liquidity; no numerical cross-currency benefit asserted.

Read official text: separate administration, manager handover, common-income/interest dedication and repair provision. No automatic dedication of separately titled rental apartments. Qualified local review required.
Read official guidance on emissions duties and different affordable/regulated housing categories. Not a universal reserve-fund rule.
Read deposit/investment channels and routes subject to rules/orders. Entity classification/current housing-specific provisions need separate review; no unrestricted securities authority asserted.
Read dated authorized-use, audit and deposit/government-bond account. Not a certification of subsequent rules.
Read repair/funding duties, trading restriction and conditioned investment power. Rental activity requires an entity/contract with actual authority.

Fee/direct/central costs hypothetical, not a valuation or empirically established scale economy.
Fixed ordinary fee plus disclosed additional work proposed with quality/conflict controls. No remuneration formula eliminates judgment or incentives.
Solvency does not establish equitable distribution; tenant payments and ownership gains need their own account.
Separate custody/portability design aims cannot erase creditor priorities, resident rights, statutory duties or underfunding.
Revisable purpose and lawful participation proposed; perpetual physical preservation not assumed desirable.
Financial continuity cannot establish environmental benefit. Embodied/operating alternatives require an independent comparison not conducted here.
Administrative pilot would test service delivery and costs, not perpetual solvency.
Continuation discounting conditional on assumed returns and 20-year window, not an actuarial or infinite-horizon result.
Negative balances preserve unpaid obligations; calls/sales are separate. Present-value calls use the common 2% real rate.
